reason: This PR looks broad and coordination-heavy rather than a narrow local fix: it rewires how DDL events feed the statistics handler, touches multiple core DDL paths (`table`, `column`, `partition`, `sequence`, `cluster`), and changes several `pkg/statistics/handle/**` event/handler interfaces. Even if intended as plumbing, this sits directly on statistics freshness after DDL, which can materially affect cardinality/cost behavior across many statements. The cross-module event propagation and coverage risk make it worth a focused deep review for missed event cases, ordering/visibility bugs, and stale-stats regressions.
